2607.09481.title: Decoupling Language Guidance from Backbones for Text-Guided Medical Segmentation
2607.09481.paper_summary: Text-guided medical image segmentation leverages clinical semantics to improve lesion delineation, yet many existing models bind cross-modal fusion, supervision, and decoder design into a task-specific architecture. Such tight coupling makes it difficult to reuse language guidance modules across heterogeneous vision and text backbones, and often requires redesigning the network when the encoder pair changes. This paper presents BTHA, a backbone-transferable hierarchical adapter framework for text-guided medical image segmentation. BTHA is built around a stable feature-level interface: given multi-scale visual features and a text representation, it injects semantic guidance through shape-preserving adapters while maintaining the decoder-side tensor contract. To make this interface effective, we introduce a Hierarchical Coarse-to-Fine Supervision Strategy that decomposes learning into global image-text alignment, multi-scale auxiliary localization, and boundary-aware final mask refinement. We further design a Scale-Adaptive Gated Semantic Guidance (SAGSG) adapter, where resolution-specific gates adaptively control textual injection and channel recalibration suppresses redundant cross-modal responses. Evaluations across diverse vision and text backbones show that the same adapter and supervision design remains effective across convolutional and transformer-based visual encoders as well as different language encoders. Experiments on four public datasets further demonstrate that BTHA improves strong text-guided baselines with modest computational overhead.
2607.09481.paper_summary_zh: 文本引導的醫學影像分割利用臨床語義來改善病變的描繪，然而許多現有模型將跨模態融合、監督和解碼器設計綁定到特定任務的架構中。這種緊密耦合使得在異質的視覺和文本骨幹之間重用語言引導模塊變得困難，並且通常在編碼器對更改時需要重新設計網絡。本文提出了BTHA，一種可轉移的層次適配器框架，用於文本引導的醫學影像分割。BTHA圍繞一個穩定的特徵級接口構建：給定多尺度視覺特徵和文本表示，它通過形狀保持適配器注入語義引導，同時保持解碼器端的張量契約。為了使這個接口有效，我們引入了一種層次粗到細的監督策略，將學習分解為全局影像-文本對齊、多尺度輔助定位和邊界感知的最終掩碼細化。我們進一步設計了一種尺度自適應門控語義引導（SAGSG）適配器，其中解析度特定的門控自適應地控制文本注入，通道重新校準則抑制冗餘的跨模態響應。在多種視覺和文本骨幹上的評估顯示，相同的適配器和監督設計在卷積和基於Transformer的視覺編碼器以及不同的語言編碼器中仍然有效。在四個公共數據集上的實驗進一步證明，BTHA以適度的計算開銷改善了強大的文本引導基線。
